replacements.text: The grilling board sent a typed answer to its slower expert seat only when the answer marked or opened a decision. Now the expert weighs every answer with a note or free text. Typed answers on the board's map can no longer trigger its escalation rules. The code for those rules remains.
The expert now weighs every human answer with a note or free text.
A typed answer that opens nothing runs at the task effort. On a channel the human moved to the expert, it keeps the heavy effort.
